projects.name: বাজার দর (BazarDor)
projects.description: A responsive Bangla market-price web application that helps users explore everyday product prices, compare market rates, and see price changes at a glance. It supports mobile, tablet, and desktop layouts and presents prices using Bengali numerals.
projects.tagline: বাজার দর — প্রয়োজনীয় পণ্যের দাম এক নজরে।
features: Responsive layouts for mobile, tablet, and desktop
Home-page sections for products whose prices have increased or decreased, plus the full product list
Product cards showing illustrations, Bengali names, units, current prices, and percentage changes
Product details with minimum, maximum, and average prices and market-wise prices
Category-based product browsing
Sorting by default order, lowest price, or highest price
Bengali numeral formatting for prices
Email/password registration and sign-in
Google and GitHub social sign-in when configured
Protected pages for authenticated users where required
Profile viewing and name updates
Toast notifications for authentication, validation, and other actions
Loading skeletons while data is fetched
Friendly not-found handling for invalid routes or missing products and categories
SEO page titles and descriptions through Next.js metadata
notes: The README lists ATL_API and DATABASE_URL as environment-variable examples; the actual service and database engine are not specified there.
Displayed prices are indicative and may vary depending on the market and current conditions.
OAuth credentials, database credentials, and other secrets should be configured in environment variables and must not be committed to the repository.

projects.name: FitLog
projects.description: A workout planner for browsing exercises and organizing a daily routine. Users can review exercise details, add exercises to today's plan, save exercises for later, and track estimated workout time and calories.
features: Browse an exercise library with descriptions, instructions, equipment, difficulty, sets, reps, duration, calories, and ratings
Add exercises to today's plan
Save exercises for later
View exercise totals, calorie totals, and total duration for the selected list
Sort planned and saved exercises by duration, calories, or rating
Remove exercises from either list
Display toast notifications for list actions

dataSource.notes: The README states that the app does not currently have a local exercise database.

stateManagement.persistence: Plan and saved-list data remain in memory while the application is running and are not persisted across page reloads.

projectStructure.src/app/: App Router pages and global styles
